title: The Sweet Orchard
author: Casper Pemberton
blurb: Juniper Crane, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, has spent ten years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the festival ends.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
